identity.title: Pocket Monsters Special Scarlet Violet volume 4

leadText: Volume 4 is the fourth volume published by Shogakukan compiling chapters from the of the Pokémon Adventures manga created by Hidenori Kusaka and Satoshi Yamamoto. The chapters in this volume are collected directly from the online publication of Pokémon Adventures.
